title: Settings-panel adjust wiring (settings_click -> effect_settings_adjust) has zero automated coverage; parity twin omits the adjust
detail: The r2 no-op class is pinned only at pure-helper level (adjust_step/cycle_*). The glue — settings_click's adjust call and effect_settings_adjust's row dispatch/pause-on-open/persist — has no test; a dropped call regresses touch/mouse palette+scale silently.
recommended_fix: Add an app-package @(test) driving settings_click on a minimal App, asserting palette/scale advance, modal swallow, and pause-on-open; or extract effect_settings_adjust's row switch into a pure tested proc.

title: Caption-while-muted a11y contract is unpinned despite the spec's explicit 'pin it'
detail: No test drains an alert while muted and asserts the caption. A regression moving set_caption inside the mute gate silences captions for muted players — the exact a11y contract — with no failing test.
recommended_fix: Add an @(test) in app/audio: toggle_mute, drain a crisis event, assert caption_live returns the crisis text while is_muted is true.

title: QoS editor geometry at x1.25/x1.50 (r2 B5 / r3 fix 2) is pinned by no unit test and no golden
evidence:
app/qos_panel.odin:357,367-370 (the r3 fix — positions derived from the same scaled rects):
			x := rnd.hud(&app.view, QOS_PANEL_X + 8 + i32(lane) * 96) // the scaled column origin (== qos_nudge_rect's x)
			draw_text(app, "-", i32(m.x) + rnd.hud(&app.view, 6), i32(m.y), rnd.hud(&app.view, 14), p.ink)
			draw_text(app, "+", i32(ppp.x) + rnd.hud(&app.view, 6), i32(ppp.y), rnd.hud(&app.view, 14), p.ink)
			between := (m.x + m.width) + (ppp.x - (m.x + m.width)) / 2 - rnd.hud_f(&app.view, 12)
			draw_text(app, wv, i32(between), y + rnd.hud(&app.view, 4), rnd.hud(&app.view, 14), p.ink)
No qos test exists (app tests: settings_test, hud_test, wire_path_test, a11y_oracle_test); harness never draws the QoS panel (grep qos in harness/ -> fixture only); demos have no select verb, so no golden renders it.
detail: The overlap/mis-hit fixes were vision-verified only. Nothing automated pins that values stay clear of the [-]/[+] buttons or adjacent lanes' columns at x1.25/x1.50 — the same defect class twice flagged by Perkins can regress silently.
recommended_fix: Add rect-geometry tests mirroring crisis_card_width_clamp: at ui_scale 1.25/1.50 assert each lane's value midpoint is outside both nudge rects and inside its own column.

title: app/audio test package (the caption seam) runs in no CI gate — its seven tests never execute
evidence:
tools/ci-local.sh:56 (gate 2, extended by this diff):
  "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && odin test app -out:bin/app-test && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test"
app/audio/audio_test.odin:1,9:
package audio
// Run: odin test app/audio    (links the stock raylib; pure tests only)
grep 'odin test' tools/*.sh -> only the gate-2 line; no gate names app/audio.
detail: odin tests one package per invocation; app/audio is a separate package. The caption priority/expiry/throttle tests backing this PR's caption-coverage claims provide zero regression protection because nothing runs them.
recommended_fix: Append '&& odin test app/audio -out:bin/audio-test' to gate 2 in tools/ci-local.sh.

title: settings_test temp-path 'hermetic' counter is racy under Odin's concurrent test runner
detail: The runner executes @(test) procs on 8 threads; the non-atomic read-modify-write can hand two tests the same temp path. Fixture writes/removes then interleave — flaky gate-2 failures or vacuous defaults-passes (missing-file leg).
recommended_fix: Key the temp path off the test's own name (unique per proc) or an atomic (sync.atomic_add_u64) instead of the racy package counter.

title: a11y demo-verb parse error paths are untested
detail: Happy path is covered by the five a11y demos + goldens; the five error returns (bad a11y/palette/scale, invalid pct, missing args) have no pin — a loosened parse only surfaces via hand-written bad demos.
recommended_fix: Add a parse_demo test: each malformed a11y line returns its error string; valid lines set a11y_palette/a11y_reduced/a11y_scale_pct.

title: Palette derivation script is executed by no gate — it can silently diverge from the shipped tables
evidence:
tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py docstring:
Usage: python3 tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py   (writes the report to stdout;
       paste the "modes" block into data/palette.json verbatim).
tools/ci-local.sh GATES=(...) — ten entries; none reference derive_a11y_palettes.py (grep 'derive_a11y' tools/ -> no hits).
detail: The r3 'twins agree exactly' claim (script vs palcheck) is unpinned: editing the script's anchors or codec changes nothing in CI. Only palcheck's separation oracle is enforced; the derivation record can rot.
recommended_fix: Add a --verify mode that emits the tables and diffs them against data/palette.json's modes block; wire it into a CI gate.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence:
harness/parity.odin:199-200 (drive_parity wiring — the settings-adjust hook is never set, so Settings_Activate is a no-op in every parity leg):
	ictx.on_right_click = on_right_click
	ictx.on_ui_press = on_ui_press
Verified live at this sha: 27/27 parity scenarios green; oracle poison+clean legs pass (min sim-dist 51.3/54.7/43.0); all five a11y .t1 manifests byte-identical to juice.t1 except the demo-name line.
detail: P0 ~90%: separation oracle, T1/replay identity, parity suppression/ownership 100%, but the panel-adjust path (~70%) has its wiring unpinned. P1 ~85%: QoS scale geometry, muted-caption leg, app/audio gate missing. Overall >=80%.
recommended_fix: Pin settings_click->adjust wiring with an app-level test; run odin test app/audio in gate 2; add the muted-caption and QoS-rect tests; fix the settings_test path race; then re-gate.
